Select molecule ChEMBL ID as molecule_chembl_id, preferred name as molecule_name, maximum clinical phase as max_phase, molecule type as molecule_type, and canonical SMILES as canonical_smiles. Join molecule_dictionary to docs via compound_records on molregno and doc_id. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1135798. Return rows sorted by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
